title: The Little Prince · 小王子的星际旅行

frames.text: On a tiny planet, a little prince watched the stars.
frames.description: 小王子站在小小星球上仰望星空。

frames.text: His home was small, but his questions were big.
frames.description: 小王子在小屋的桌前思索，身边放着地球仪和星球草图。

frames.text: He wondered what was waiting beyond the sky.
frames.description: 小王子通过望远镜探索遥远星河。

frames.text: One morning, a red rose opened in the sunlight.
frames.description: 红玫瑰在清晨阳光中绽放，花瓣上挂着露珠。

frames.text: The little prince brought her water every day.
frames.description: 小王子拿着水壶，给红玫瑰浇水。

frames.text: Taking care of her made his small world feel warm.
frames.description: 暮色中，小王子轻轻为玫瑰盖上玻璃罩，屋里亮着温暖灯光。

frames.text: One day, the prince followed the birds into the sky.
frames.description: 小王子跟着飞鸟离开自己的星球。

frames.text: His golden scarf danced behind him in the wind.
frames.description: 飞行途中，金色围巾在风中舒展飘舞。

frames.text: He carried a thousand questions and a memory of his rose.
frames.description: 小王子坐在远方的月亮上，捧着象征玫瑰的纪念，思念自己的家。

frames.text: Far away, a pilot had landed in a quiet desert.
frames.description: 飞行员独自坐在降落的飞机旁，四周是清晨的沙漠。

frames.text: The prince sat beside him as the morning light grew.
frames.description: 小王子坐在飞行员身旁，两人认真交谈。

frames.text: In that great sea of sand, two strangers became friends.
frames.description: 小王子和飞行员并肩走过沙丘，已经成为朋友。

frames.text: Under a tree, a fox waited in the golden grass.
frames.description: 一只橙色狐狸独自在金色草地的大树下等待。

frames.text: Each day, the prince sat a little closer to his new friend.
frames.description: 小王子在几步之外安静坐下，与狐狸慢慢熟悉。

frames.text: They learned that friendship grows when we give it time.
frames.description: 狐狸已经依偎在小王子身旁，两位朋友亲密相伴。

frames.text: That night, the prince looked up at the shining stars.
frames.description: 小王子在夜晚的山丘上仰望闪烁星光。

frames.text: Somewhere among them, his little rose was waiting.
frames.description: 远方的小星球上，玫瑰在玻璃罩中静静等候。

frames.text: The sky felt full of friends, and he no longer felt alone.
frames.description: 小王子微笑望着星空，狐狸和飞行员的星座让他感到朋友相伴。
